title: USING A TRAINED MODEL OF AN ONLINE SYSTEM TO GENERATE ACTION RECOMMENDATIONS BY PREDICTING FUTURE DEMAND
technical_field: The present disclosure relates generally to inventory management, and more specifically to systems and methods for predicting future demand of items and generating action recommendations for retailers.
background_art: Inventory management is a difficult task, as manually checking inventory and maintaining efficient inventory levels is burdensome and not feasible for large scale. The inventory management is also typically difficult for infrequently purchased items, seasonal or trending items, as well as keeping track of different shopkeepers of each item. Currently, retailers typically rely on manual processes for less frequently purchased items, for example, for less frequently purchased items. For example, this may be a demand-driven cause for purchases for some period of time, so retailers may not immediately realize that certain items are out-of-stock and therefore require them to be replenished. Also, the demand can change quickly, and retailers typically do not have the time to react to a constant stream of changes. Therefore, there is a technical problem of how to implement inventory management in a systematic manner on a large scale without the requirement of a manual process.
summary_of_invention: The present disclosure relates to a system and method for predicting future demand of items and generating action recommendations for retailers. The system utilizes a trained model of an online system to predict future demand, which is used to generate action recommendations for retailers. The online system gathers in-store data from devices of pickers or computing systems mounted to physical receptacles used for shopping at a retailer's location. This data, along with conversion data, is used to estimate the inventory level of an item. A trained demand prediction model is then applied to predict a demand prediction score, indicative of future demand. Based on the estimated inventory level and the demand prediction score, a depletion metric is generated, indicating the time until the inventory is depleted. Finally, based on the depletion metric, action data is generated to trigger one or more actions in relation to the inventory, such as resupply recommendations or alerts, which are communicated to the retailer's computing system.

detailed_description: The detailed description outlines an example system environment and architecture for an online concierge system, including various modules such as data collection, content presentation, order management, machine learning training, data store, inventory prediction, demand prediction, and action application. It describes the roles and functionalities of different components like user client devices, picker client devices, retailer computing systems, and the network. The system leverages data from various sources, including picker data, smart shopping cart data, and conversion data, to predict future demand for items. This prediction is used to generate a demand prediction score and a depletion metric, which in turn trigger action recommendations for retailers, such as resupply alerts or auto-orders. The system also details how machine learning models are trained, updated, and utilized for inventory prediction and demand forecasting. Specific examples are provided, such as the use of cameras and weight sensors on smart shopping carts to gather in-store data, and how picker feedback can refine inventory predictions. The document also explains how the system can proactively manage inventory by predicting depletion and suggesting timely actions to retailers to prevent stockouts and optimize supply chain operations. The claims section further elaborates on the specific methods and systems for achieving these functionalities.
claims: A method, performed at a computer system comprising a processor and a computer-readable medium, comprising: gathering in-store data by receiving, via a network from at least one of a device of a picker associated with an online system or a computing system mounted to a physical receptacle utilized for shopping at a location of a retailer associated with the online system, data with information about an inventory of an item at the location of the retailer; obtaining conversion data with information about conversions of the item associated with a plurality of orders placed at the online system; estimating, based at least in part on the conversion data, a level of inventory for the item at the location of the retailer; accessing a demand prediction model of the online system, wherein the demand prediction model is trained to predict a future demand for the item; applying the demand prediction model to predict, based on the in-store data, the conversion data and the estimated level of inventory, a demand prediction score for the item indicative of the future demand for the item for a defined future time period; generating, based on the estimated level of inventory and the demand prediction score, a depletion metric for the item indicative of a time period until the inventory of the item is depleted at the location of the retailer; generating, based on the depletion metric, action data associated with one or more actions in relation to the inventory of the item; and communicating, to a computing system associated with the retailer via the network, the action data prompting the one or more actions in relation to the inventory of the item.

abstract: A trained model of an online system is used to generate action recommendations by predicting future demands. The online system gathers in-store data by receiving, from a device of a picker and/or a computing system of an in-store physical receptacle, data with information about an inventory of an item. The online system estimates, based on conversion data for the item, a level of inventory for the item. The trained model is then applied to predict, based on the in-store data and the estimated level of inventory, a demand prediction score indicative of a future demand for the item. The online system generates, based on the estimated level of inventory and the demand prediction score, a depletion metric indicative of a time period until the inventory of the item is depleted. Based on the depletion metric, the online system triggers an action in relation to the inventory of the item.
